lede: The biggest thing on the calendar this week is Wednesday's joint work session where the Planning Commission and Board of County Commissioners sit down together to dig into proposed Land Use Code amendments covering forestry, oil and gas, geothermal operations, and condominium plats — the kind of session where the shape of future decisions gets set, even without a final vote. Same evening, the commissioners hold a rare West End meeting in Norwood, taking up a Planning Commission appointment and hearing results from the Placerville Fire Survey. The Ecology Commission is also meeting Wednesday to review the 2022 Climate Action Plan with a focus on transportation, land use, and consumption.

notable.stake: Commissioners appoint Planning Commission alternate; fire survey results presented.
Climate Action Plan review targets transportation and consumption policy directions.
Land Use Code amendments covering forestry, oil, gas, geothermal, and condo plats under review.
